Mission-ready platforms

Tideman Marine designs and manufactures mission-ready fire boats and rescue boats for fire departments, municipalities, emergency response agencies, harbor authorities, and public safety organizations. Built from durable HDPE, Tideman Marine boats provide rugged, low-maintenance platforms for marine firefighting, search and rescue, flood response, dive operations, emergency medical response, and public safety missions.

From compact, shallow-draft rescue boats to larger, fully outfitted fire boats, Tideman Marine platforms can be configured around the specific equipment, personnel, waterways, and response requirements of each department.

Whether responding on lakes, rivers, harbors, coastal waters, flood zones, or shallow waterways, Tideman Marine builds fire and rescue boats around the mission.

settings.editor: F-Series

settings.title: F-Series Flat Series Fire Boats and Rescue Boats

settings.editor:
The Tideman Marine F-Series, or Flat Series, is a versatile HDPE platform that can be configured for fire rescue and emergency response operations. Its shallow-draft design makes the Flat Series particularly well suited for departments that need access to rivers, lakes, flood zones, shorelines, and other areas where water depth or submerged hazards may limit conventional rescue vessels.

Configured as a rescue boat, the F-Series can support marine firefighting, search and rescue, flood response, dive operations, emergency medical response, victim recovery, and public safety missions.

The featured General Arrangement (GA) print showcases a 23' long × 8'6" beam Tideman Marine F-Series Flat Series platform outfitted specifically for fire rescue operations.

The Flat Series provides emergency response teams with a rugged and versatile rescue boat platform designed around shallow-water access, stability, deck space, and mission flexibility.

HDPE construction

settings.title: HDPE Fire Boats and Rescue Boats

settings.editor:
Tideman Marine constructs its vessels using High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE), providing characteristics that are particularly well suited for professional fire boats and rescue boats.

Emergency response vessels may encounter docks, submerged objects, debris, rocky shorelines, shallow water, saltwater, and other demanding conditions. HDPE provides departments with a rugged hull material designed for these real-world marine environments.

settings.title: Why HDPE Works for Fire Boats and Rescue Boats

image.alt: Deck detail of a Tideman Marine HDPE rescue boat with life ring and equipment case

settings.editor: HDPE provides excellent impact resistance for operations around docks, debris, rocky shorelines, and other demanding environments.
HDPE does not corrode from exposure to freshwater or saltwater, making it well suited for long-term marine service.
The HDPE hull does not require the same corrosion protection associated with many traditional marine materials.
HDPE is nonconductive and is not subject to galvanic corrosion.
HDPE itself is naturally buoyant, an important characteristic for a marine hull material.
HDPE construction works particularly well with rugged, shallow-draft workboat designs such as the F-Series Flat Series.
HDPE is designed to provide years of demanding marine service with relatively low hull maintenance.
If damage does occur, HDPE can be welded and repaired.

For departments whose rescue boats may encounter submerged debris, damaged docks, rocky shorelines, flood-related hazards, or other challenging conditions, HDPE can provide an important operational advantage.
More platforms

settings.title: Other Tideman Marine Series for Fire Boats and Rescue Boats

settings.editor:
While the F-Series Flat Series provides an excellent shallow-draft platform for fire rescue operations, other Tideman Marine boat series can also be configured as fire boats and rescue boats.

The right platform depends on the department's waterways, crew size, equipment, operating conditions, required range, and primary mission.

settings.title: I-Series Inland Patrol Fire Boats and Rescue Boats

settings.editor: The I-Series Inland Patrol is a strong option for fire departments operating on lakes, rivers, harbors, and inland waterways.

tabs.tab_content:
Configured as a fire rescue boat, the Inland Patrol can support marine firefighting, search and rescue, dive operations, emergency medical response, harbor patrol, and personnel transport.

Inland Patrol Rescue Boats for Emergency Response

An I-Series Inland Patrol rescue boat can be configured with equipment such as fire pumps and monitors, emergency lighting, searchlights, rescue equipment storage, electronics, communications equipment, dive access, and specialized crew seating.

This combination makes the Inland Patrol an option for departments that need one boat to perform both routine public safety and emergency response missions.

settings.title: I-Series Inland Utility Fire Boats and Rescue Boats

settings.editor: For departments that prioritize deck space, stability, and equipment capacity, the I-Series Inland Utility provides another versatile platform for fire boats and rescue boats.

tabs.tab_content:
The Inland Utility can provide valuable working space for pumps, hoses, rescue equipment, divers, medical personnel, and recovered victims.

Inland Utility Fire Department Rescue Boats

An Inland Utility fire department rescue boat could be particularly well-suited for:

  • Flood response
  • Shallow-water rescue
  • Dive operations
  • Equipment transport
  • Victim recovery
  • Emergency medical response
  • Marine firefighting
  • Disaster response

Its open-working platform also provides departments with flexibility in determining where specialized fire and rescue equipment should be positioned.

settings.title: I-Series Inland Landing Craft Rescue Boats

settings.editor: The I-Series Inland Landing Craft provides another approach to emergency response by offering direct access between the vessel and shoreline.

tabs.tab_content:
Landing Craft Rescue Boats for Flood and Disaster Response

A bow ramp can make it easier to move rescue personnel, equipment, patients, and emergency supplies between the rescue boat and shore.

This can make an Inland Landing Craft particularly useful for:

  • Flood response
  • Disaster response
  • Evacuations
  • Shoreline rescue
  • Emergency equipment deployment
  • Personnel transport
  • Medical response
  • Access to isolated areas

For departments responding where roads, docks, or conventional access points have been compromised, a landing craft-style rescue boat can provide additional mission flexibility.

settings.title: C-Series Coastal Patrol Fire Boats and Rescue Boats

settings.editor: For departments operating in larger harbors, ports, coastal waterways, and more demanding marine environments, the C-Series Coastal Patrol provides a larger platform for a highly capable fire boat.

tabs.tab_content:
The Coastal Series can provide additional room and payload capacity for larger firefighting systems, rescue equipment, medical equipment, electronics, crew accommodations, and command systems.

Coastal Fire Boats for Ports and Harbors

A C-Series Coastal Patrol fire rescue boat can be configured for:

  • Marine firefighting
  • Port and harbor response
  • Search and rescue
  • Dive operations
  • Vessel assistance
  • Emergency medical response
  • Coastal patrol
  • Extended emergency response missions

For departments covering large harbors, coastal areas, ports, or more exposed waterways, the C-Series provides another option for a highly capable fire and rescue boat.

settings.editor: The C-Series Coastal Utility provides a substantial working deck for departments requiring a heavy-duty fire boat with room for firefighting and rescue systems.

tabs.tab_content:
Coastal Utility Fire Boats with Working Deck Space

The working deck can be configured around equipment such as:

  • Fire pumps
  • Fire monitors
  • Hose storage

  • Rescue gear
  • Medical equipment
  • Generators
  • Emergency equipment
  • Specialized storage

For a department looking for a working fire boat rather than a traditional patrol-style layout, the Coastal Utility provides another highly configurable HDPE platform.

settings.title: C-Series Coastal Landing Craft Fire and Rescue Boats

settings.editor: The C-Series Coastal Landing Craft can provide fire and rescue agencies with a heavy-duty emergency response platform capable of moving personnel and equipment directly to a shoreline.
